name: adas-log-toolchain-lab

scripts.demo: node src/cli.ts gen --out out && node src/cli.ts parse out/events.jsonl --out out/anomalies.json && node src/cli.ts cases boundary --out out/cases && node src/cli.ts cases regression --anomalies out/anomalies.json --log out/events.jsonl --out out/cases && node src/cli.ts replay --manifest out/cases/manifest.json --out out/replay-report.json
